decision: Reject pairwise seam equality as sufficient terrain-closure evidence, require an assembled finite-window topology audit, and correct exact-isovalue endpoint handling before cell-level triangle cleanup.
reason: The 3x3x2 observatory rendered a visible tangent-pole opening while all 33 adjacent chunk pairs matched. An independent edge-multiplicity audit of the assembled window found 24 interior open edges and zero non-manifold edges. The chunks agreed because the same required triangles had already been removed before chunk canonicalization. Moving the existing [1/32, 31/32] endpoint interpolation policy into the shared native cell backend retains those triangles before degenerate cleanup. The unchanged fixture then reports zero interior openings and zero non-manifold edges. A closed tetrahedron and the same tetrahedron with one face removed prove that the new lab audit accepts a closed surface and detects an injected three-edge opening. The policy changes exact TQP-11 construction and TQP-12 resolution geometry signatures; both are rebaselined only after their classifications, counts, seams, collision checks, materials, and all other Gate B invariants pass.
qualified_scope: the unchanged canonical 3x3x2 Terrain Observatory fixture
edge multiplicity across all 10264 assembled regular triangles
zero interior open edges and zero non-manifold edges
open edges permitted only when both endpoints lie on one exterior volume plane
native debug and release exact-isovalue cell and smoothed-crater window regressions
rebaselined TQP-11 and TQP-12 exact geometry signatures with unchanged passing semantic invariants
Cell Lab parity under the pinned corrected native source and binaries
held_scope: human visual acceptance remains pending for the recaptured observatory images
mixed-LOD transition-window topology remains governed by its separate fixtures
other fields, edit histories, renderers, GPUs, and platforms remain governed by their own evidence
explicit_non_claims: no claim that finite-window closure proves every possible scalar field
no claim that pairwise seam checks are unnecessary
no fallback mesher or moved fixture
